title: What Comes Next?
short: Put the steps of a little story in order.

blocks.html: Things happen in order. First an egg, then a chick hatches, then a fluffy chick! What comes next in each little story?

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: First the egg, then the chick hatches, then the chick.

blocks.html: Stories and everyday things happen in an order.

For the grown-up: Retell a favorite book in order: “What happened first? Then what?” Take three photos of building a tower and let your child put them in order. Short and happy beats long. Five minutes is a good lesson.

items: Try it at home: Retell a story in order.
Plant a seed and watch what comes next.
Put three picture cards in order.
